Docs·Start here

Start it the first time

Double-click the launcher for Windows or macOS. What the first run sets up, how long it takes, and what you see when it is ready.

The first start takes about three minutes, because the launcher downloads and sets up what the converter needs. Every start after that takes a second or two.

On Windows

  1. Open the app folder and double-click start.bat.
  2. A black window with white text opens. This is the launcher. Leave it open.
  3. It works through four numbered steps. [1/4] Checking Python... looks for Python and prints the version it found.
  4. [2/4] Checking local Python environment... creates the folder .venv (about 30 seconds) and installs the add-ons (one to three minutes). You need an internet connection for this step.
  5. [3/4] Starting the local server... starts the small server that the app runs on, and prints its address, normally http://localhost:4242.
  6. The app opens in a window of its own and shows the start screen.

If the launcher finds no Python, it offers to install Python 3.12 for you. Press Y to accept. See What you need.

On macOS

  1. Open the app folder and double-click start.command.
  2. If macOS refuses with “Operation not permitted”, right-click start.command and choose “Open”. macOS blocks a double-click on a freshly unzipped script the first time.
  3. A Terminal window opens. It creates the folder .venv, installs the add-ons, and prints Starting server....
  4. The app opens and shows the start screen.

What you see

The start screen has links to Help, the keyboard shortcuts and Settings at the top, and a row of tiles: Open file… (or drop a file anywhere on the screen), New scene to start with nothing and Import… to add a file to the scene that is already open. Under them are four shapes to start from (Cube, Sphere, Cylinder and Torus) and the list of recent files, with a search box above it and a Clear all button. The list is empty the first time.

Good to know

  • The launcher window is the server. If you close it, the app stops working. Keep it open while you work and see Stop, restart and update for the tidy way to quit.
  • The app opens in a window with no address bar and no browser tabs when Chrome, Edge or Brave is installed. Without one of those, it opens as a tab in your usual browser. Both work the same.
  • The address is normally http://localhost:4242. If something else on your computer already uses that number, the launcher tries another one and prints the address it chose.
  • It uses your usual browser profile, so your settings and recent files are remembered between starts.

Start with a file

On Windows you can drag a .step or .glb file onto start.bat instead of double-clicking it. The app starts and opens that file. For a STEP file the launcher window first asks a few questions, such as the tessellation quality. Press Enter at each question to accept the suggested answer.
